description: This file contains fuzz testing code for the web_hub component of Mattermost, including setup, connection handling, and fuzzing logic.

methods.name: dummyWebsocketHandler
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket server handler that upgrades HTTP connections and reads messages until error.

methods.name: registerDummyWebConn
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection, registers it with the app, and starts pumping messages.

methods.name: getActionData
methods.description: Parses input byte slice to generate an actionData struct with event and IDs for fuzzing actions.

methods.name: Fuzz
methods.description: Main fuzzing function that initializes server once, then processes input data to simulate WebSocket events and interactions.

methods.name: generateInitialCorpus
methods.description: Generates initial random data files for go-fuzz corpus.
